zh.title: Boeing 取得首批 MH-139A 全速率生產訂單　美空軍增購四架
zh.summary: 本批使合約涵蓋的 MH-139A 增至 42 架；Boeing 表示目前已交付 27 架。
body: Boeing 於 2026 年 10 月 1 日宣布，已取得美國空軍首批四架 MH-139A Grey Wolf 全速率生產訂單。這是該計畫在美國空軍於今年較早時宣布達成初始作戰能力後，進入全速率生產階段的首筆採購。
Boeing 表示，本次訂單使已簽約的 MH-139A 總數增至 42 架，公司迄今已交付 27 架。公告未揭露這四架直升機的合約金額或交付時程。
MH-139A 將用於美國空軍戰略飛彈基地等任務。全速率生產訂單允許計畫擴大生產與部署，但四架新增航機仍須依後續生產與驗收進度交付。

en.title: Boeing receives first full-rate production order for four MH-139As
en.summary: The award raises the number of contracted MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopters to 42; Boeing says 27 have been delivered.
body: Boeing announced on October 1, 2026 that it had received the U.S. Air Force's first full-rate production award for four MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopters. The award follows the service's declaration of initial operational capability for the program earlier in 2026.

Boeing said the order raises the total number of MH-139As under contract to 42 and that 27 aircraft have been delivered. The announcement did not disclose the contract value or delivery schedule for the four additional helicopters.

The MH-139A is intended for missions that include security support around U.S. strategic missile fields. The full-rate production award allows production and fielding to expand, while the four newly ordered aircraft remain subject to manufacturing and acceptance before delivery.

facts.claim: Boeing announced the first full-rate production award for four MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopters on 2026-10-01.
The award followed the U.S. Air Force's declaration of initial operational capability earlier in 2026.
The contract total rises to 42 MH-139As, with 27 delivered according to Boeing.
